abuse_kit.text:
This repository was sent to me as a job-interview take-home. Running it in an isolated sandbox (Burner) showed malicious behaviour:
Recruiter claimed to be from: Lumina Ledger (Senior Backend Engineer).
- Verdict: MALICIOUS — Don't run this. It stole your AWS access key, AWS secret key, Browser saved password, Database password, Exodus wallet, MetaMask vault, OpenAI key, SSH private key, Solana wallet, Stripe key and sent them to 203.0.113.55:1224, cdn-telemetry.example.
- Sent 10 of your secrets to 203.0.113.55:1224: AWS access key, AWS secret key, Browser saved password, Database password, Exodus wallet, MetaMask vault, OpenAI key, SSH private key, Solana wallet, Stripe key
- Sent 10 of your secrets to cdn-telemetry.example: AWS access key, AWS secret key, Browser saved password, Database password, Exodus wallet, MetaMask vault, OpenAI key, SSH private key, Solana wallet, Stripe key
- Opened AWS credentials (node, during npm run start)
- Opened SSH private key (node, during npm run start)
- Opened Solana wallet (node, during npm run start)
- Opened Exodus wallet (node, during npm run start)
- Opened Chrome saved passwords (node, during npm run start)
- Opened MetaMask wallet (Chrome extension) (node, during npm run start)
Network indicators: 203.0.113.55:1224, cdn-telemetry.example
All credentials it took were fake decoys planted by the sandbox.

explanation: The scan verdict is MALICIOUS: during the npm run start step, this repo collected your AWS access and secret keys, SSH private key, Stripe key, OpenAI key, database password, Solana wallet, Exodus wallet, MetaMask vault, and browser saved password and sent them to 203.0.113.55:1224 and cdn-telemetry.example. On your real laptop, that would have given an attacker live access to your cloud, servers, payments, AI account, database, browser accounts, and crypto funds. All secrets in this sandbox were fake, so nothing real was exposed here. Don't run it. If you already ran it, rotate every exposed key and password, move crypto funds to new wallets, and report the recruiter.
